title: Divya Shakti
desc: A young reporter, Prashant Verma, tired of injustice, bears witness to a murder case and wages war against Tau. But in the process, his life and family members get threatened.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalein
desc: After graduating from a university in India, an unemployed man decides to try his luck in New York and gets caught in a love triangle between an equally unlucky girl and a rich girl.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.
